north_star.description: Maintain a concise standalone skill that preserves outcomes and proven capability fitness across evolution.

fitness_dimensions.description: Proportionate time, tokens, tools, and proof cost.
Authority, evidence integrity, bounded effects, and recovery.

delivery_stages.description: Verify and publish the generic schema-v4 capability-floor contract.
Add generic atomic action admission and candidate-bound proof without regressing released behavior.
Keep bounded reversible work direct while making complex-work admission cross the real model-to-tool boundary.

outcome_capabilities.description: Preserve parented outcomes, accepted behavior, and honest evidence.
Keep execution, proof, and communication proportionate and productive.
Remain generic, backward-readable, valid, tested, and idempotently installable.
Refuse material work before stable lineage, candidate proof, prerequisites, budgets, and exact effects are atomically admitted.
Intercept each covered material tool proposal, bind its actual identity and inputs, meter bounded work, and stop a disproven method family before execution continues.
Deliver bounded reversible work without letting setup, orchestration, proof, or recovery become a larger substitute outcome.

capability_floors.invariant: Later stages preserve every declared permanent behavior and reject completion without whole-system evidence.
Ordinary changes use cheap deterministic gates while stronger proof is reserved for installation and release boundaries.
The exact generic source remains valid, backward-readable, isolated, and equal to the installed copy.
Every material attempt is atomically reserved against stable lineage, a complete candidate, aggregate budgets, prerequisite evidence, and exact effect authority before it starts.
A covered material tool call cannot execute without a live single-use reservation for its actual tool, inputs, method family, scope, and remaining bounded-work budget.
One bounded reversible deliverable stays direct unless observed properties of the user outcome require durable execution.

identity_requirements.description: The standalone skill repository and active installed outcome-integrity skill.

state_transitions.reason: Record the exact inherited expensive-attempt admission stop before one bounded RC2 recovery.
Resume only the final RC2 forward proof after the exact one-ceiling extension was recorded.

limit_extensions.reason: Permit exactly one final expensive RC2 forward proof after inherited RC1 work exhausted the prior ceiling.
